rating_weights.description: Combined player rating = form_weight * Form + class_weight * Class + divergence_weight * recent variance. Sum = 1.0

form_calculation.description: Rolling 5-match form on raw stats for player's position group, z-scored. Bench minutes excluded to isolate playing form.

class_calculation.description: Performance-weighted ELO, similar to xLadder team Class. Initialized at 2000, updates on player's per-minute performance vs peer group.

positional_benchmark.description: 0-100 scale where 50 = peer group median across all competitions. Calculated from rolling 5-match percentile within position + competition.

competition_translation_model.method: Ridge regression on historical NRL↔SL transfers
competition_translation_model.description: How a player's expected performance translates across leagues. E.g. -0.5 = expect 0.5 z-score drop in SL.

weekly_update_schedule.pipeline: parse → normalize → aggregate to player-match → compute ratings → update Sheet

data_quality_thresholds.description: Ratings computed only when player meets these thresholds (e.g., form only if played 20+ mins that week)
